assets.subject: the Signature café room at early evening: polished honey-walnut plank floor glowing in warm sunset light, terracotta wainscot with a thin gold trim, cream walls, a big window with a green gingham valance and a string of warm fairy lights, a peach-and-gold sunset sky outside, hanging pothos plants and brass pendant lamps, wooden bookshelves with recipe books, jars and fresh flowers, a chalkboard menu with a little golden star above it and an arched doorway
assets.details: On the left, continue the wall past the bookshelf with another tall shelf of recipe books, jars and small vases of flowers under a glowing brass pendant lamp. On the right, continue past the arched doorway with the terracotta wainscot, a warm wall lamp, a small wooden side table with a vase of flowers and a hanging plant.
